options.name: --backend
options.description: GPU backend: auto, vulkan, cuda. Default: auto (prefers  CUDA when -g is set and CUDA is available, otherwise Vulkan).

options.name: --cpu-moe
options.description: MoE: keep ALL routed expert weights on the CPU (llama.cpp  --cpu-moe). Sets SHARPI_CPU_MOE=1, overriding the VRAM-fit auto-select;  SHARPI_CPU_MOE=0 in the env still forces on-GPU experts. Alias --cmoe  (llama.cpp's single-dash -cmoe isn't representable: Spectre short  options must be one character).

options.name: --ctx-size
options.description: Context size / max sequence length (0 = model default)

options.name: --device
options.description: GPU device to offload to: index (0,1,…), name (CUDA0, Vulkan1), or 'none' for CPU. Default: auto. Single-device only (no  multi-GPU split). Mirrors llama.cpp's --device.

options.name: --draft-lookup
options.description: Speculative decoding via prompt-lookup (n-gram) drafting  — proposes tokens by matching the generated tail against  prompt+history; no draft model needed (greedy only, requires --temp 0)

options.name: --dspark-min-confidence
options.description: Floor on the DSpark confidence head's predicted  acceptance probability; positions below it are trimmed from the verify batch.  Unset resolves via SHARPI_DSPARK_MIN_CONFIDENCE, then 0 = verify the whole  block.

options.name: --dspark-model
options.description: Path to a DSpark draft-head model.safetensors  (deepseek-ai/DeepSpec, e.g. dspark_qwen3_4b_block7) with its config.json  alongside. Enables DSpark block-speculative decoding (greedy only, CPU target  for now — PR #413 spec).

options.name: --dspark-place
options.description: Where the DSpark draft head runs: auto (default; planner  decides from VRAM/RAM headroom), gpu, cpu, off. Unset resolves via  SHARPI_DSPARK_PLACE. An explicit value pins the mode outright, like -g pins the  layer split.

options.name: --dspark-verify-len
options.description: Cap on draft tokens verified per DSpark step. Unset  resolves via SHARPI_DSPARK_VERIFY_LEN, then 0 = the confidence scheduler decides (up to the head's block size).

options.name: --expert-stats
options.description: MoE: write GPU expert-cache (SLRU) hit-rate stats to this  file on exit. Env: SHARPI_EXPERT_STATS.

options.name: --file
options.description: Read the prompt from a file (llama.cpp -f/--file).  Overrides -p when both are given; useful for prompts longer than the  shell's command-line limit.

options.name: --gpu-moe-prefill
options.description: CPU-MoE: run the routed-expert prefill matmuls on the GPU  (transient weight upload, like llama.cpp's op-offload) instead of CPU dots. Default ON (#390); pass 'false' to force the CPU MoE prefill. Sets  SHARPI_MOE_GPU_PREFILL. ~+28-67% PREFILL on the CUDA GDN-hybrid CPU-MoE  models, with DECODE within noise of the CPU path — the register-in-place  pin mode (SHARPI_MOE_PIN_MODE, default 'register') cudaHostRegisters  the expert mmap pages instead of a ~14 GB copy, so no RAM duplicate and no  page-cache eviction; a token gate (SHARPI_MOE_GPU_PREFILL_MIN_TOKENS, default  64) keeps tiny prefills + decode on the CPU path. Argmax-stable (GPU runs  the MoE in F32), not bit-identical to CPU. Auto-falls-back to the CPU path if  the GPU scratch can't allocate.

options.name: --hide-thinking
options.description: Hide reasoning output (the model still reasons; only the  answer is shown)

options.name: --image
options.description: Path to a PNG image for multimodal input (Gemma 4  encoder-free vision). Repeatable for multiple images; reference each with an  <image> marker in -p (left-to-right), or omit markers to prepend them. Requires --mmproj and a text prompt (-p). Runs on CPU, CUDA (full + partial offload), and Vulkan (full offload).

options.name: --json-schema
options.description: JSON schema to constrain the entire response to  (https://json-schema.org/), e.g.  '{"type":"object","properties":{...},"re quired":[...]}' (llama.cpp -j/--json-schema). Root must be an object  schema declaring at least one property; unsupported keywords ($ref, oneOf/anyOf, pattern, minLength/maxLength, minimum/maximum) degrade to unconstrained.  Mutually exclusive with --json-schema-file.

options.name: --json-schema-file
options.description: File containing a JSON schema to constrain the entire  response to (llama.cpp --json-schema-file/-jf; alias --jf since llama.cpp's single-dash -jf isn't representable: Spectre short options must be one  character). Mutually exclusive with --json-schema.

options.name: --json-schema-ordered
options.description: With --json-schema/--json-schema-file: require properties  in declaration order (issue #425) -- optional properties may be skipped but  never reordered. Lets a streaming consumer act on an early field before a later, larger one finishes.

options.name: --kv-type
options.description: KV-cache element type for the CUDA backend: fp32  (default), bf16 (half the KV VRAM → ~2x context), or q8_0 (quarter →  ~4x). Like llama.cpp --cache-type-k/v. Env: SHARPI_KV_DTYPE.

options.name: --max-thinking-tokens
options.description: Maximum reasoning tokens before forcing  </think>. 0 = unlimited (default). Not honored on the  speculative-decode path.

options.name: --min-batch-blas
options.description: Minimum batch size to use OpenBLAS SGEMM in MatMulBatched  (default: 16, crossover for Q4_K_M weights). Also settable via  SHARPI_MIN_BATCH_BLAS env var.

options.name: --min-p
options.description: Min-p sampling (default: 0.05)

options.name: --mmproj
options.description: Path to the multimodal projector GGUF (mmproj-*.gguf).  Required with --image. Mirrors llama.cpp's --mmproj.

options.name: --model
options.description: Path to GGUF model file

options.name: --model-draft
options.description: Path to a smaller draft model for speculative decoding  (greedy only, requires --temp 0). Mirrors llama.cpp's --model-draft.

options.name: --moe-warmpin
options.description: MoE: also pin the top-N hottest experts per layer into the GPU cache after warmup (default 0 = off; frequency-aware eviction already  retains hot experts). Env: SHARPI_MOE_WARMPIN.

options.name: --moe-warmpin-after
options.description: MoE: expert accesses to observe before warm-pinning  selects the hot set (default 512). Only used with --moe-warmpin. Env:  SHARPI_MOE_WARMPIN_AFTER.

options.name: --n-cpu-moe
options.description: MoE: keep the routed experts of N layers on the CPU  (llama.cpp --n-cpu-moe). DEFERRED / not yet supported —  SharpInference's expert placement is all-or-nothing (no per-layer split in  the engine), so passing any value errors with that rationale. Use --cpu-moe (all on CPU) or omit (auto).

options.name: --n-predict
options.description: Number of tokens to predict (default: 512)

options.name: --ngl
options.description: Layers on GPU (0=CPU only, -1=all, default: 0). Mirrors  llama.cpp's --n-gpu-layers/--ngl.

options.name: --no-display-prompt
options.description: Don't echo the prompt

options.name: --no-moe-predict-prefetch
options.description: MoE: disable next-layer predictive expert prefetch  (Vulkan; on by default). Env: SHARPI_MOE_PREDICT_PREFETCH=0.

options.name: --no-thinking
options.description: Disable reasoning mode (sets enable_thinking=false in the  chat template)

options.name: --prefill-dequant-cache-mb
options.description: Dequant-once BLAS weight-cache budget in MiB for CPU  prefill (issue #189): caches the F32 dequant per projection weight so chunked  prefill re-pays no dequant (bit-identical). Auto (env SHARPI_PREFILL_DEQUANT_MB  / fit-25%-RAM) by default; 0 = off, negative = unlimited. CPU only.

options.name: --prompt
options.description: Input prompt (default: interactive chat)

options.name: --repeat-penalty
options.description: Repetition penalty (1.0 = disabled, >1.0 penalizes  repeated tokens, default: 1.1). Mirrors llama.cpp's --repeat-penalty.

options.name: --seed
options.description: RNG seed (-1 = random, default: -1)

options.name: --single-turn
options.description: Generate one response and exit

options.name: --spec-draft-n-max
options.description: Max draft tokens per MTP step (issue #30 batched verify).  Unset resolves via SHARPI_MTP_DRAFT_N, then defaults to 1 (a 2-token verify  batch — the measured optimum). Values > 1 also need snapshot-ring  slots: set SHARPI_MTP_BATCH_MAX >= drafts+1 (default 2; each extra  slot costs ~150 MiB VRAM on 27B). Mirrors llama.cpp.

options.name: --spec-draft-n-min
options.description: Min draft tokens per MTP step (default: 0). Mirrors  llama.cpp. Currently rejected at parse time when > 0 since N=1 is the only  supported draft length; issue #37.

options.name: --spec-draft-p-min
options.description: Min draft probability for MTP probabilistic accept  (default: 1.0 = strict argmax-match, byte-identical to no-MTP baseline). 0.75  mirrors llama.cpp; values in (0, 1) accept drafts whose softmax probability  under the verifier meets the threshold even when they aren't argmax (issue  #38).

options.name: --spec-lookahead
options.description: Number of draft tokens per speculative step with  --draft-model (default: 4)

options.name: --spec-type
options.description: Speculative decoding type: auto (default; enables MTP when supported), none, mtp (alias: draft-mtp), dspark (requires --dspark-model).  Mirrors llama.cpp.

options.name: --system-prompt
options.description: System prompt

options.name: --temp
options.description: Temperature (0 = greedy, default: 0.7)

options.name: --thinking
options.description: Enable reasoning mode (sets enable_thinking=true). Needed  for Gemma 4 reasoning finetunes, which default off because stock Gemma 4  instruct models aren't reasoning-trained.

options.name: --tool-grammar
options.description: Constrain tool-call arguments to the --tools JSON Schemas  (issue #374): required keys can't be dropped, only declared keys/enum  values appear, value shapes match the declared type. Needs --tools and a model  family with constraint support (Gemma 4, Qwen/Qwen3-Coder, Llama-3, DeepSeek).  Default off → byte-identical to unconstrained decoding.

options.name: --tools
options.description: Path to a JSON file of OpenAI-format tool definitions  ([{type:"function", function:{name, description, parameters}}, ...],  or a {"tools":[...]} wrapper). Advertised to the model via its chat  template; on a single-prompt (-p) run the parsed tool calls are printed after  generation.

options.name: --top-k
options.description: Top-k sampling (0 = disabled, default: 40)

options.name: --top-p
options.description: Top-p nucleus sampling (default: 0.95)

options.name: --tq
options.description: Enable TurboQuant KV cache compression (3-bit, reduces  VRAM ~5x)

options.name: --tq-mode
options.description: TurboQuant quantizer for --tq: lloydmax (default; 3-bit  Lloyd-Max codebooks) or kvarn (issue #180: Sinkhorn-normalized asymmetric RTN,  4-bit K / 2-bit V, 128-token tiles; CPU (-g 0, any power-of-2 head dim ≤  1024) or full-CUDA-offload dense (-g -1, head dim ≤ 256); no SnapKV).

options.name: --verbose-prompt
options.description: Print token IDs before generating

commands.name: image

options.name: --backend
options.description: (Z-Image) Force compute backend: auto (default), cuda, vulkan, cpu

options.name: --cfg-scale
options.description: Guidance scale — not used for Z-Image  (distilled), 1.0 for FLUX schnell (default: auto)

options.name: --clip-l
options.description: (FLUX) Path to CLIP-L encoder safetensors

options.name: --clip-tokenizer
options.description: (FLUX) Path to CLIP tokenizer.json

options.name: --device
options.description: (Z-Image) GPU to use: auto (default), none/cpu, an  index (0, 1), or a named device (CUDA0, Vulkan1)

options.name: --height
options.description: Output image height in pixels — must be divisible by 16 (default: 512)

options.name: --model
options.description: Path to diffusion model GGUF or safetensors directory  (FLUX.1, Z-Image-Turbo, …)

options.name: --negative-prompt
options.description: Negative prompt — what to avoid in the generated  image

options.name: --ngl
options.description: (Z-Image) GPU acceleration: -1 = auto  (CUDA→Vulkan→CPU, default), 0 = CPU only

options.name: --output
options.description: Output PNG file path (default: output.png)

options.name: --prompt
options.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate

options.name: --qwen-encoder
options.description: (Z-Image) Path to Qwen3-4B GGUF text encoder (from  Qwen/Qwen3-4B-GGUF)

options.name: --qwen-tokenizer
options.description: (Z-Image) Path to Qwen3 tokenizer.json

options.name: --sd-cli
options.description: Path to sd-cli executable used when --use-sdcpp is set (overrides SHARPI_SDCPP env var)

options.name: --seed
options.description: RNG seed (-1 = random, default: -1)

options.name: --steps
options.description: Denoising steps (default: 4 for Z-Image-Turbo, 4 for  FLUX schnell, 20 for dev)

options.name: --t5-tokenizer
options.description: (FLUX) Path to T5 tokenizer.json

options.name: --t5xxl
options.description: (FLUX) Path to T5-XXL encoder safetensors

options.name: --text-encoder
options.description: (sd-cli mode only) Path to LLM-style text encoder  GGUF

options.name: --upscale-blend
options.description: Blend factor for the upscaled result (0.0–1.0).  1.0 = full RRDB (sharpest), <1.0 softens by blending with bicubic. Default  1.0.

options.name: --upscaler
options.description: Path to ESRGAN/Real-ESRGAN upscaler weights  (.safetensors). Upscales the generated image by ×2 or ×4 before  saving.

options.name: --use-sdcpp
options.description: Delegate to stable-diffusion.cpp sd-cli instead of  native pipeline (for comparison)

options.name: --vae
options.description: Path to VAE safetensors file or directory  (ae.safetensors or vae/ dir)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show per-step timing and progress

options.name: --width
options.description: Output image width in pixels — must be divisible  by 16 (default: 512)

commands.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using a native FLUX  or Z-Image-Turbo diffusion pipeline (VAE + CLIP-L + T5-XXL + DiT  GGUF). See 'sharpi-cli image --help' for required model paths.

commands.name: list-metadata

options.name: --model
options.description: Path to GGUF model file

commands.description: Print all GGUF metadata key/value pairs from a model  file

commands.name: list-tensors

options.name: --filter
options.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on tensor name

options.name: --layer
options.description: Show only tensors for this layer index (matches  blk.<N>.*)

options.name: --model
options.description: Path to GGUF model file

options.name: --summary
options.description: Group tensors by name suffix; show count and total  bytes per group

commands.description: Print the tensor index (name, dtype, shape, bytes) from a  model file

commands.name: perplexity

options.name: --ctx-size
options.description: Number of tokens to evaluate (default: 2048). Clamped  to the model context length and the corpus length.

options.name: --file
options.description: UTF-8 text file to evaluate (llama.cpp -f/--file).  Tokenized raw (no chat template); the first -c tokens are scored.

options.name: --model
options.description: Path to GGUF model file

options.name: --ngl
options.description: Layers on GPU: 0 (default, CPU forward pass) or -1  (full CUDA offload via CudaForwardPass — issue #180 Task 5a). Partial  offload is not supported.

options.name: --tq
options.description: Enable TurboQuant KV cache compression (same flag as  the run command)

options.name: --tq-mode
options.description: TurboQuant quantizer for --tq: lloydmax (default;  3-bit Lloyd-Max codebooks) or kvarn (issue #180: 4-bit K / 2-bit V, 128-token  tiles; CPU only).

options.name: --tq-window
options.description: FP32 recent-token window before compression kicks in  (default: 256; min 128 for kvarn — one full tile). Also sets the first  position-bucket edge of the report, so pass the same value to the fp32 baseline  for bucket-comparable numbers.

commands.description: Teacher-forced perplexity over a text file (llama.cpp  llama-perplexity analogue; CPU only). Reports mean NLL, perplexity, and  position-bucket NLLs — the TurboQuant/KVarN accuracy gate (issue #180).
